topology.protocolsEmpty: No protocol yet. Click "New protocol" to auto-generate links from the inventory.
topology.protocolMappingHint: Pick the inventory category and the columns holding neighbor information.
topology.protocolAggregationHintNew: Tells where to find, per port, its LAG / Port-channel membership. The category can be the same as LLDP or a dedicated inventory category (e.g. "Port-channel members"). The join key is the value of a column from the LLDP row (defaults to the local port), and the aggregation value is read from a column of the target category. When set, generated edges automatically inherit this aggregation group and are visually bundled (requires the link aggregation option enabled on the map).
topology.protocolMatchInventoryKeyHelp: Optional filter: only consider entries whose entryKey matches this key.
topology.protocolMatchInventoryHint: Resolves the neighbor by looking it up in this inventory category. The optional key narrows down to specific rows; the value column holds the cell content that must match the "Neighbor column" field.
topology.protocolWizardProtocolHint: Pick the protocol used to derive the links.
topology.protocolWizardLldpDesc: Link Layer Discovery Protocol. Builds links from each device's neighbor table.
topology.protocolWizardIsisDesc: Intermediate System to Intermediate System. Builds IS-IS adjacencies with area handling.
topology.protocolWizardStpDesc: Spanning Tree Protocol. Highlights the root bridge and each link's state (active / blocked) from STP port data.
topology.protocolWizardMstpDesc: Multiple Spanning Tree. Same as STP but per instance (MSTI), with a root and a state per instance.
topology.protocolStpDesignatedHelp: On each port row, the column holding the designated bridge's Bridge ID — that's how the neighbor is resolved.
topology.protocolStpInstanceHelp: If empty, the instance ID is read from the port's entryKey suffix ("port:instance" format, e.g. "Gi0/1:1").
topology.protocolStpBridgeHint: Inventory category describing the local bridge: one row per device with its Bridge ID and the Root ID it sees.
topology.protocolMstpBridgeHint: Inventory category describing the bridge per instance: one row per (device × instance), entryKey is the instance ID.
topology.protocolMstpBridgeCategoryHelp: MSTP: one row per instance, entryKey = instance ID.
topology.protocolStpRootIdHelp: Used to mark the root bridge: the device whose Bridge ID matches its Root ID is flagged as root.
topology.protocolStpLocalHint: How to read, for each device, the identifier its LLDP neighbors will see (hostname, chassis ID, ...). This value is compared to the "neighbor" column on the LLDP category.
topology.protocolStpLocalEntryKeyHelp: Optional: only consider rows whose entryKey matches this key (e.g. "default").
topology.protocolStpLocalColumnHelp: Column whose value identifies this device to its neighbors (e.g. "Bridge Address", "Hostname", "Chassis ID").
topology.protocolStpAdjacencyHint: LLDP category: one row per local port with the neighbor identifier and the remote port.
topology.protocolStpRemoteNeighborHelp: Value is compared to the "Value column" of another device's Local identity to resolve the adjacency.
topology.protocolStpStateHint: May live in a different category. The local port is matched against the LLDP category, duplicated per instance for MSTP.
topology.protocolStpStatePortHelp: If empty, the entryKey is used (stripping a trailing :instance suffix if present).
topology.protocolStpPriorityHelp: STP port priority (typically 128, tunable to influence the tie-breaker). Displayed in parentheses next to the port name when an instance is selected.
topology.protocolStpLldpHint: LLDP inventory category: one row per local port with the neighbor's hostname / chassis ID. The neighbor is resolved to a Node via the Node resolution section (Mapping step).
topology.protocolStpLldpLocalPortHelp: Column holding the local port name. If empty, the entryKey of the LLDP row is used as port name.
topology.protocolStpLldpNeighborHelp: Value is compared against the nodes' name / hostname / IP, or an inventory cell when Resolution = Inventory field.
topology.protocolWizardStyleHint: Appearance of the generated links on the map.
topology.protocolAggregationHint: Generated links will join the given aggregation group (if aggregation is enabled).
topology.protocolIsisAreasHint: On the link entries, pick the column that holds the qualifier (typically "Area" with values like HOME/REMOTE). That value is used as a key to look up the real area address in the next category. Nodes in the same area get an auto-cluster, and links are grouped by area when aggregation is enabled.
